cues.zh: 从前，一条恶龙肆虐王国。
cues.en: Once upon a time, a dragon tyrannized the kingdom.

cues.zh: 它身披厚厚的黑色鳞片，双眼闪烁着仇恨的光芒……
cues.en: Covered with thick black scales, its eyes glowed with hate ,…

cues.zh: ……可怕的巨口中流出恶臭的黏液。
cues.en: … and from its terrible jaws flowed evil-smelling slime.

cues.zh: 有人试图与恶龙搏斗……
cues.en: Some tried to fight the dragon …

cues.zh: ……祭司和魔法师降下诅咒，却无济于事。
cues.en: … priests and magicians called down curses to no avail.

cues.zh: 勇士们手持最好的武器发起攻击，结果却被烧成灰烬。
cues.en: Warriors, armed with the best weapons, attacked, only to be incinerated.

cues.zh: 恶龙的利爪、巨口和火焰如此致命……
cues.en: The dragon’s claws, jaws, and fire were so effective, …

cues.zh: ……鳞甲又如此坚硬，使它几乎无敌。
cues.en: … its scaly armor so hard, as to make it invincible.

cues.zh: 恶龙向人类索要贡品：……
cues.en: The dragon demanded from humankind a tribute: …

cues.zh: ……一万名男女，随机挑选……
cues.en: … ten thousand men and women, randomly chosen, …

cues.zh: ……每天傍晚送到山脚下供它吞食。
cues.en: … to be delivered every evening to the foot of the mountain to be eaten.

cues.zh: 国王和臣民们武器无用……
cues.en: The king and the kingdom, their weapons useless, …

cues.zh: ……别无选择，只能献上这骇人的贡品……
cues.en: … had no choice but to pay the grisly tribute, ….

cues.zh: ……承受苦难，填饱那永不满足的饥渴。
cues.en: … to suffer the misery, to feed the insatiable hunger.

cues.zh: 而人类向来善于适应，渐渐把这条暴君般的巨龙当成了生活的一部分；……
cues.en: And humans, ever adaptable, came to accept the dragon-tyrant as a fact of life; …

cues.zh: ……他们心知肚明，甚至坦然接受：每个人最后的时刻都会在它的巨口中度过。
cues.en: … knowing, even embracing, that everyone’s final moments would be in its maw.

cues.zh: 世界还能是什么别的样子呢？
cues.en: How could the world be otherwise?

cues.zh: 王国开始教育孩子，说巨龙在自然秩序中有它的位置……
cues.en: The kingdom began to teach its children that the dragon had its place …

cues.zh: ……甚至说，身为人的意义，最终就是……
cues.en: … in the natural order and, the very meaning of being human to end up …

cues.zh: ……葬身龙腹；正因为寿命短暂，人们才更努力地过好一生。
cues.en: … in the dragon’s stomach, their shorter lives motivating them to lead good lives.

cues.zh: 而巨龙也在帮王国一个忙：控制人口……
cues.en: And the dragon was helping the kingdom by keeping the population …

cues.zh: ……不至于增长过快。
cues.en: … from growing too fast.

cues.zh: 得知这一点后，人们对巨龙的攻击停止了。
cues.en: Learning this, attacks on the dragon ceased.

cues.zh: 但王国仍在缓慢扩张，巨龙也随之长大，……
cues.en: But the kingdom still grew, slowly, and with it so did the dragon, …

cues.zh: ……变得和它栖居的那座山一样庞大，胃口也与日俱增。
cues.en: … becoming as big as the mountain on which it lived, its appetite increasing.

cues.zh: 每天要收集并运送这么多人……
cues.en: The logistics of collecting and transporting so many every day…

cues.zh: ……上山，这件事在国王心中占的分量，已经超过了那些死亡，也超过了巨龙本身。
cues.en: … to the mountain came to occupy the king’s mind more than the deaths and the dragon itself.

cues.zh: 国王不得不雇用登记员，记录谁将被送去。
cues.en: The king had to hire registrars to keep track of who would be sent.

cues.zh: 收人者被派去押送指定的受害者。
cues.en: There were people-collectors dispatched to fetch the designated victims.

cues.zh: 还有职员负责发放给被屠戮家庭的抚恤金。
cues.en: There were clerks who administered the pensions to be paid to decimated families.

cues.zh: 还有安慰者会与注定赴死的人同行……
cues.en: And there were comforters who would travel with the doomed …

cues.zh: ……在前往巨龙那里的路上，试图减轻痛苦。
cues.en: … on their way to the dragon, trying to ease the anguish.

cues.zh: 还有龙学家研究如何让这些后勤流程更高效。
cues.en: And there were dragonologists who studied how these logistic processes could be made more efficient.

cues.zh: 蒸汽机被发明出来，还修建了一条通往巨龙居所的铁路。
cues.en: Steam engines were invented and a railway constructed leading to the dragon’s abode.

cues.zh: 火车满载着人抵达山间终点站，返回时却空空如也。
cues.en: Trains arrived at the mountain terminal crammed with people and return empty.

cues.zh: 一些龙学家还研究巨龙的行为并收集样本……
cues.en: Some dragonologists also studied the dragon’s behavior and collected samples …

cues.zh: ……它脱落的鳞片、黏液，以及夹杂着人骨碎片的粪便。
cues.en: … its shed scales, the slime, the excrement speckled with fragments of human bone.

cues.zh: 越了解这头猛兽，就越能确认它不可战胜。
cues.en: The more the beast was understood, the more its invincibility confirmed.

cues.zh: 但……人类是个好奇的物种。
cues.en: But. . . humanity is a curious species.

cues.zh: 每隔一段时间，总有人会想到好点子。
cues.en: Every once in a while, someone gets a good idea.

cues.zh: 其他人会复制这个点子，并加入自己的改进。
cues.en: Others copy the idea, adding to it their own improvements.

cues.zh: 随着时间推移，许多奇妙的工具和系统被开发出来。
cues.en: Over time, many wondrous tools and systems are developed.

cues.zh: 其中一些工具让产生新想法变得更容易。
cues.en: Some of these tools make it easier to generate new ideas.

cues.zh: 于是，发明的巨轮……
cues.en: Thus, the great wheel of invention, …

cues.zh: ……在更古老的时代转得慢得难以察觉……
cues.en: … which in the older ages turned imperceptibly slow, …

cues.zh: ……开始加速，人类做出了以前看似魔法的事情……
cues.en: … began to accelerate and humans did what would have seemed magic before, …

cues.zh: ……跨越遥远距离即时通信，制造能飞的机器，
cues.en: … communicating instantly across great distance, building machines that could fly,

cues.zh: ……以及许多其他令人惊叹的东西。
cues.en: … and many other astonishing things.

cues.zh: 少数龙学家主张，也许是时候发动一次新的攻击了……
cues.en: A few dragonologists argued it might be time argued for a new attack …

cues.zh: ……有人发明了一种锋利到能刺穿龙鳞的材料。
cues.en: … one had invented a material so sharp it could pierce a dragon’s scale.

cues.zh: 这并不容易，但如果能用这种材料造出一个巨大的弹丸……
cues.en: It would not be easy but if a huge projectile could be made out of this material …

cues.zh: ……再以足够的力量和精度发射出去，也许就能穿透龙的盔甲。
cues.en: … and launched with sufficient force and sufficient precision it might penetrate the dragon’s armor.

cues.zh: 然而，做这件事困难、昂贵又耗时。
cues.en: However, it would be difficult and expensive and time-consuming to do.

cues.zh: 龙学家们向任何愿意听的人解释他们的方案。
cues.en: The dragonologists explained their proposal to anyone who would listen.

cues.zh: 但人们对此怀疑；他们一直被教导说，龙暴君不可战胜，而它要求的献祭是生活中理所当然的事。
cues.en: But the people were skeptical; they had been taught the dragon-tyrant was invincible and the sacrifices it demanded a fact of life.

cues.zh: 然而，当他们得知这种新材料和弹丸的构想后，许多人产生了兴趣。
cues.en: Yet when they learnt about the new material and the idea for a projectile, many became intrigued.

cues.zh: 国王读到这些计划后，决定举行一场公开听证会……
cues.en: When the king read about the plans, he decided to hold an open hearing …

cues.zh: ……听证会在一年中最末、最黑暗的一天举行，地点是皇家城堡最大的厅堂。
cues.en: … it took place on the last and darkest day of the year, in the largest hall of the royal castle.

cues.zh: 人们挤满了每一个座位，过道里也站满了人。
cues.en: People packed in to every last seat and crowded the aisles.

cues.zh: 国王的顾问先发言：告诉民众，最好接受龙的出现不可避免……
cues.en: The king's advisor spoke first: telling the people it was best they accept the inevitability of the dragon…

cues.zh: ……而龙务管理部门提供了许多工作岗位……
cues.en: … and the dragon-administration department provided many jobs …

cues.zh: ……一旦龙被宰杀，这些岗位就会消失，况且无论如何……
cues.en: … that would be lost were the dragon slaughtered and, in any case, …

cues.zh: ……修建新铁路之后，王国的国库已经空了。
cues.en: … the kingdom's coffers were empty after building the new railway.

cues.zh: 接着，首席龙学家解释了拟议装置将如何运作……
cues.en: Next the leading dragonologist explained how the proposed device would work, …

cues.zh: ……以及如何制造所需数量的新发明材料。
cues.en: … how the requisite amount of new invented material could be manufactured.

cues.zh: 按所申请的资助额度来看，这项工作或许能在十五到二十年内完成。
cues.en: Given the requested amount of funding, it may be possible to complete the work in fifteen to twenty years.

cues.zh: 资助更多的话，也许十二年。不过，无法保证。
cues.en: With greater funding, maybe twelve. However, there could be no guarantee.

cues.zh: 最后发言的是国王的道德顾问：
cues.en: Last to speak was the king’s advisor for morality:

cues.zh: “就算我们承认，”他说，“这个项目在技术上可行，尽管还没向我证明。……
cues.en: "Let us grant" he said "The project is technologically possible, though it hasn’t been proven to me. …

cues.zh: ……想必你们认为自己有权不被吃掉。
cues.en: … Presumably, you think you've got the right not to be chewed up.

cues.zh: 多么任性，多么狂妄，多么虚荣。人生短暂，反倒是一种福气。
cues.en: How willful, how presumptuous, how vain. The shortness of human life is a blessing.

cues.zh: 除掉龙看似很方便，却会损害我们的尊严。
cues.en: Getting rid of the dragon, which might seem such a convenient thing to do, would undermine our dignity.

cues.zh: 这种对杀龙的执念，会使我们无法更充分地实现……
cues.en: This preoccupation with killing the dragon will deflect us from realizing more fully …

cues.zh: ……我们生命天然指向的那些抱负，无法好好生活，而只是勉强活着。
cues.en: … the aspirations to which our lives naturally point, from living well rather than merely staying alive.

cues.zh: 龙的天性是吃，而朋友们，我们的天性，唯有被吃才能高贵地实现。
cues.en: The nature of the dragon is to eat, and our own nature, my friends, is nobly fulfilled only by getting eaten.

cues.zh: 龙是必需的。龙是善的。
cues.en: The dragon is necessary. The dragon is good."

cues.zh: 大厅里一片寂静。
cues.en: The great hall was silent.

cues.zh: 这时，观众里有个小孩大喊：“龙是恶的！”
cues.en: Then a small child yelled out from the audience: "The dragon is bad!"

cues.zh: 孩子的父母涨红了脸，连忙制止，可孩子又说：
cues.en: The child’s parents turned red and hushed, but the child said again:

cues.zh: “龙是恶的——它杀人……它吃了我奶奶……我要我奶奶回来。”
cues.en: "The dragon is bad -- it kills people... it ate my Granny... I want my Granny back."

cues.zh: 大厅再次陷入寂静——然后一位女士站了起来：“那条龙杀死了我的父母。”
cues.en: The hall was silent again -- then a woman stood: “The dragon killed my parents.”

cues.zh: 一个男人也跟着站了起来：“那条龙杀死了我的妻子和女儿。”
cues.en: And man followed and stood: “The dragon killed my wife and my daughter.”

cues.zh: 越来越多的人站了起来——龙杀死了所有人，这个简单的事实、由此带来的失去、它的沉重，一齐压向大厅。
cues.en: More and more people stood -- the simple fact that the dragon killed everyone, the loss of it, the weight of it, crashing over the hall.

cues.zh: 摆脱这一切的出路看似渺茫，但或许仍有可能。
cues.en: The way out from under remote, yet maybe possible.

cues.zh: 国王看着第一个开口的孩子，宣布：“让我们去杀死那条龙。”
cues.en: The king, looking at the first child to speak, announced: "Let us kill the dragon".

cues.zh: 第二天早上，十亿人醒来后意识到，在投射物发射之前，他们或他们所爱的人可能会被送去给龙。
cues.en: The next morning, a billion people woke to realize they or those they loved might be sent to the dragon before the projectile launched.

cues.zh: 而在此之前，对反龙事业的积极支持一直有限，……
cues.en: Whereas before, active support for the anti-dragon cause had been limited, …

cues.zh: ……如今，它已成为所有人心中头等的要务和关切。
cues.en: … it now became the number one priority and concern on everyone’s mind.

cues.zh: 群众集会为抛射物项目筹款，并敦促国王加大支持，……
cues.en: Mass rallies raised money for the projectile project and urged the king to increase support, …

cues.zh: 他照做了，通过额外拨款法案，还卖掉了自己的夏宫，并宣布：
cues.en: … which he did, passing extra appropriations bills and selling his summer castle, announcing:

cues.zh: “我相信，这个王国应当致力于实现这个目标，……
cues.en: "I believe that this kingdom should commit itself to achieving the goal, …

cues.zh: ……在十年之内，让世界摆脱龙这一古老祸患。”
cues.en: … before the decade is out, of freeing the world from the ancient scourge of the dragon."

cues.zh: 于是，一场与时间赛跑的伟大技术竞赛开始了。
cues.en: Thus started a great technological race against time.

cues.zh: 制造屠龙武器需要解决成千上万个技术问题，……
cues.en: To make the dragon-killing weapon required solutions to a thousand technical problems, …

cues.zh: ……其中每一项都需要几十个耗时步骤，还免不了走弯路。
cues.en: … each of which required dozens of time-consuming steps and missteps.

cues.zh: 试验导弹发射后，要么直接坠地，要么飞错方向。
cues.en: Test-missiles were fired but fell dead to the ground or flew off in the wrong direction.

cues.zh: 发生了可怕的事故。
cues.en: Terrible accidents happened.

cues.zh: 但如今有了一种认真笃定的目标感，工作继续推进。
cues.en: But there was now a seriousness of purpose, and the work continued.

cues.zh: 但尽管资金几乎不受限制，技术人员也夜以继日地工作，国王设定的最后期限仍无法赶上。
cues.en: But despite almost unlimited funding and round-the-clock work by technicians, the king’s deadline could not be met.

cues.zh: 这项任务十分艰巨。
cues.en: The task was hard.

cues.zh: 十年过去了，巨龙依然活着——也依然在吃。
cues.en: The decade concluded and the dragon still lived — still ate.

cues.zh: 但他们的努力正越来越接近目标。
cues.en: But the effort was getting closer.

cues.zh: 一年后，首枚原型导弹成功发射。
cues.en: A year later the first prototype missile successfully launched.

cues.zh: 最后一枚弹体的建造终于定在新年前夜完成并发射，……
cues.en: The construction of the final projectile eventually set to complete and launch on New Year’s Eve, …

cues.zh: ……此时距项目启动已过去十二年。
cues.en: … twelve years after the project’s inauguration.

cues.zh: 一年的最后一天寒冷阴沉，但无风而清朗——发射条件良好。
cues.en: The last day of the year was cold and overcast, but still and clear — good launch conditions.

cues.zh: 夕阳西下时，技术人员来回奔忙，做最后的调整和检查。
cues.en: As the sun set, technicians scuttled around making the final adjustments and checks.

cues.zh: 国王和顾问们在靠近发射台的平台上观看。
cues.en: The king and his advisors observed from a platform close to the launch pad.

cues.zh: 更远处，围栏后面，民众聚集起来见证这一重大事件。
cues.en: Further away, behind a fence, the public assembled to witness the great event.

cues.zh: 一个巨大的时钟正在倒计时：还剩十分钟——远处是巨龙漆黑佝偻的轮廓，正在进食。
cues.en: A large clock counted down: ten minutes to go -- the dark slumped profile of the dragon beyond, eating.

cues.zh: 人群中有人翻过围栏，跑向国王所在的高台。
cues.en: From the crowd, someone jumped the fence and ran to the platform where the king sat.

cues.zh: 他在安保人员陪同下赶到，神情狂乱，鼻子流着血。
cues.en: He arrived, accompanied by security, in a frenzied state, his nose bleeding.

cues.zh: 他喊道：“最后一班列车！停下最后一班列车！”
cues.en: He shouted: "The last train! Stop the last train!"

cues.zh: 这个年轻人是交通部的一名初级职员。
cues.en: The young man was a junior clerk in the ministry of transportation.

cues.zh: 他发现自己的父亲就在开往山里的最后一班列车上。
cues.en: He had discovered that his father was on the last train to the mountain.

cues.zh: 国王曾下令列车一直运行到终点，……
cues.en: The king had ordered the trains to continue to the very end, …

cues.zh: ……因为担心任何干扰都可能惊动巨龙，导致导弹打偏。
cues.en: … fearing any disruption might cause the dragon to stir and the missile to miss.

cues.zh: 年轻人恳求国王下令召回最后一班列车，……
cues.en: The young man begged the king to issue a recall-order for the last train, …

cues.zh: ……那班车预计在零时前五分钟抵达山中终点站。
cues.en: … due to arrive at the mountain terminal five minutes before time zero.

cues.zh: “我做不到，”国王说，“我不能冒这个险，那会惊动巨龙。”
cues.en: "I cannot do it," said the king, "I cannot take the risk it will alert the dragon“.

cues.zh: 他们头顶的云层倾泻出雨水。
cues.en: The clouds above their head let loose the rain.

cues.zh: “我很抱歉，”国王继续说道，“要是我们哪怕早一天开始，你父亲就不必死了。”
cues.en: “I am so sorry” The king continued, “had we started but one day earlier your father would not have to die.”

cues.zh: 望着人群，想着他们和他所承受的所有失去。
cues.en: Looking at the crowd, thinking of all the losses that they and he, had endured.

cues.zh: “这个项目本该比我们实际启动的年份早很多年就开始。
cues.en: “This project should have been started years earlier than we did.

cues.zh: 如果我们能早些从对它的恐怖的默认中醒悟，那么多人本不必死于巨龙之手。”
cues.en: So many need not have been killed by the dragon, had we but awoken from our acceptance of its horror sooner.”

cues.zh: 年轻人的恸哭停止了。
cues.en: The young man's wailing ceased.

cues.zh: 国王抬头看向倒计时时钟：还剩五秒。
cues.en: The king looked up at the countdown clock: five seconds remaining.

cues.zh: 四。
cues.en: Four.

cues.zh: 三。
cues.en: Three.

cues.zh: 二。
cues.en: Two.

cues.zh: 一。
cues.en: One.

cues.zh: 零。
cues.en: Zero.

cues.zh: 一团火球吞没了发射台，导弹激射而出。
cues.en: A ball of fire enveloped the launch pad and the missile shot out.

cues.zh: 民众、国王，无论低微还是高贵，无论年轻还是年老……
cues.en: The masses, the king, the low and the high, the young and the old…

cues.zh: ……那道射入黑暗的白色火焰，正是人类精神的化身，承载着恐惧与希望。
cues.en: ... that white flame, shooting into the dark embodied the human spirit, its fear and its hope.

cues.zh: 它击中了邪恶的核心。
cues.en: It struck the heart of evil.

cues.zh: 天边那道剪影翻滚着倒下了。
cues.en: The silhouette on the horizon tumbled and fell.

cues.zh: 成千上万人的欢呼声从人群中响起，几秒后又汇入倒塌巨兽发出的一声震耳欲聋、绵长的闷响。
cues.en: Thousands of voices of joy rose from the masses, joined seconds later by a deafening drawn-out thud from the collapsing monster.

cues.zh: 历经这一切，人类终于摆脱了巨龙。
cues.en: After all this time, humanity was at last free from the dragon.

cues.zh: 欢呼声化作喜庆的吟唱：
cues.en: The joy cry resolved into a jubilating chant:

cues.zh: “国王万岁！我们所有人万岁！”
cues.en: "Long live the king! Long live us all!"

cues.zh: 王室随从在倾盆大雨中挤作一团，聚拢到君主周围。
cues.en: The royal entourage, huddling in the downpour, accumulated around their monarch.

cues.zh: 过去一小时里，发生了太多变化。
cues.en: So much had changed in the last hour.

cues.zh: 重获了拥有开放未来的权利，一种原始恐惧被消除，许多长期持有的假设被推翻。
cues.en: The right to an open future had been regained, a primordial fear abolished, and many long-held assumptions overturned.

cues.zh: “我们现在该怎么办？”他们问道。
cues.en: “What do we do now?" they asked.

cues.zh: “我们走了很远……”国王说，“可如今我们又像孩子一样。
cues.en: "We have come a long way. . ." said the king, "yet now we are like children again.

cues.zh: 未来在我们面前展开。
cues.en: The future lies open before us.

cues.zh: 我们要努力比过去做得更好，因为现在我们有了时间……
cues.en: We shall go and try to do better than we have done in the past, for we have time now…

cues.zh: ……有时间把事情做对，有时间成长，有时间从错误中学习。
cues.en: … time to get things right, time to grow up, time to learn from our mistakes.

cues.zh: 让王国里所有的钟都鸣响至午夜，以缅怀我们的逝者。
cues.en: Let all the bells in the kingdom ring until midnight, in remembrance of our dead.

cues.zh: 之后，我们将庆祝，并开始建设一个更美好的世界……因为现在我们有了时间。
cues.en: Then after, we will celebrate and begin the process of building a better world. . . for we have time now.
